
=== Procedure: Reportes.PrensadoInterrupEnCurso ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	
	for each DB.PrensadoInterrupcion
		where PrensadoInterrupcionId > 0
		where PrensadoId = &PrensadoId
		where InterrupcionId > 0
		where InterrupcionConcluida = false
		&EnCurso = true
		Exit
	when none
		&EnCurso = false
	endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&PrensadoId, out:&EnCurso);


=== Transaction: DB.PrensadoInterrupcion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated PrensadoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"PrensadoId"
					&Insert_PrensadoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated InterrupcionId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InterrupcionId"
					&Insert_InterrupcionId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		PrensadoInterrupcionWW.Call()
	Endif
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&PrensadoInterrupcionId);

PrensadoInterrupcionId = &PrensadoInterrupcionId if not &PrensadoInterrupcionId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(PrensadoInterrupcionId);
noprompt(PrensadoInterrupcionId);

PrensadoId = &Insert_PrensadoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_PrensadoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(PrensadoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_PrensadoId.IsEmpty();
InterrupcionId = &Insert_InterrupcionId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InterrupcionId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InterrupcionId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InterrupcionId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditPrensadoInterrupcion.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, PrensadoInterrupcionId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditPrensadoInterrupcion.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, PrensadoInterrupcionId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditPrensadoInterrupcion.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, PrensadoInterrupcionId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditPrensadoInterrupcion.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, PrensadoInterrupcionId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditPrensadoInterrupcion ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each PrensadoInterrupcion
		Where PrensadoInterrupcionId = &PrensadoInterrupcionId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'PrensadoInterrupcion'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PrensadoInterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = PrensadoInterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PrensadoId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Prensado Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = PrensadoId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each PrensadoInterrupcion
		Where PrensadoInterrupcionId = &PrensadoInterrupcionId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'PrensadoInterrupcion'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PrensadoInterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PrensadoInterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PrensadoId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Prensado Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PrensadoId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PrensadoInterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PrensadoInterrupcionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PrensadoId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PrensadoId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&SaveOldValues, inout:&AuditingObject, in: &PrensadoInterrupcionId, in:&ActualMode);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.PrensadoInterrupcionView ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&AuditTableName = !'PrensadoInterrupcion'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	WorkWithLink.Link = DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWW.Link()
	For each PrensadoInterrupcion
		where PrensadoInterrupcionId = &PrensadoInterrupcionId
		Form.Caption = "Prensado Interrupcion"
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "WWP_RecordNotFound"
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	If (&Exists)
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tabs.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'LoadFixedTabs'
		Do 'LoadTabs'
	Endif
	&RecordDescription = Form.Caption
	If &Session.Get(!'DiscussionThreadIdToOpen') <> ''
		ddc_Discussions.Open()
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If Not WWP_HasDiscussionMessages(!'PrensadoInterrupcion', PrensadoInterrupcionId.ToString().Trim())
		ddc_Discussions.Icon = "far fa-comment"
	EndIf
	If (WWP_HasSubscriptionsToDisplay(!'PrensadoInterrupcion', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord))
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = True
	Else
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = False
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddc_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'PrensadoInterrupcion', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord, PrensadoInterrupcionId.ToString().Trim(), &RecordDescription)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddc_Discussions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_DiscussionsWC.Create(!'PrensadoInterrupcion', PrensadoInterrupcionId.ToString().Trim(), &RecordDescription, DB.PrensadoInterrupcionView.Link(PrensadoInterrupcionId, ''))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Tabs.TabChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&SelectedTabCode = Tabs.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'LoadTabs'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Form.Caption = ' Prensado Interrupcion'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	PrensadoInterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	PrensadoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	InterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoInterrupcionId'
					&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoId'
					&TFPrensadoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionId'
					&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.PrensadoInterrupcion.Link(TrnMode.Update, PrensadoInterrupcionId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.PrensadoInterrupcion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, PrensadoInterrupcionId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.PrensadoInterrupcion.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(PrensadoInterrupcionId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'PrensadoInterrupcion', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"PrensadoInterrupcionWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId.IsEmpty() AND &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Interrupcion Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPrensadoId.IsEmpty() AND &TFPrensadoId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFPrensadoId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFPrensadoId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionId.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFInterrupcionId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFInterrupcionId_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each PrensadoInterrupcion
		order PrensadoInterrupcionId  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PrensadoInterrupcionId)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order PrensadoId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PrensadoId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionId  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionId)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using PrensadoInterrupcionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId, &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To, &TFPrensadoId, &TFPrensadoId_To, &TFInterrupcionId
					, &TFInterrupcionId_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'PrensadoInterrupcionId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = PrensadoInterrupcionId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'PrensadoId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = PrensadoId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InterrupcionId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = InterrupcionId
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new GeneXusSecurity.WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"PrensadoInterrupcionId", '', !'Interrupcion Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"PrensadoId", '', !'Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InterrupcionId", '', !'Id', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSADOINTERRUPCIONID"
				&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSADOID"
				&TFPrensadoId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFPrensadoId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINTERRUPCIONID"
				&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.PrensadoInterrupcionWWExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensadointerrupcionww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Prensado Interrupcion List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId.IsEmpty() AND &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFPrensadoInterrupcionId
		&TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Interrupcion Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPrensadoId.IsEmpty() AND &TFPrensadoId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFPrensadoId
		&TFPrensadoId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFPrensadoId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInterrupcionId.IsEmpty() AND &TFInterrupcionId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionId
		&TFInterrupcionId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFInterrupcionId_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each PrensadoInterrupcion
		order PrensadoInterrupcionId  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PrensadoInterrupcionId)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order PrensadoId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PrensadoId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InterrupcionId  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InterrupcionId)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using PrensadoInterrupcionWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId, &TFPrensadoInterrupcionId_To, &TFPrensadoId, &TFPrensadoId_To, &TFInterrupcionId
					, &TFInterrupcionId_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
